_comment: Needs-expert-review register. Each item is exported into the data pack as a review flag so the game and instructors can see what is provisional. Close an item by setting status to 'resolved' with the reviewer's decision.

items.title: Corn nitrogen rate: SL129 plant-population table vs. interim yield-goal rule

options.summary: SL129 Table 2, irrigated corn: 180 / 210 / 240 lb N/A at 20,000 / 25,000 / 30,000 plants/acre
1.37 lb N per bushel of yield potential (interim, approved September 3, 2025): 137 / 206 / 274 / 343 lb N/ac at 100 / 150 / 200 / 250 bu/ac

items.notes: Both rules are stored in the data pack. Default chosen by the project owner on 2026-10-20 so that Increment 3 tests can match SL129. Changing the default is a one-line edit here.

items.title: Re-pricing Georgia 2024 custom rates for Florida diesel and labor
items.notes: No sourced Florida-vs-Georgia diesel and farm-labor cost ratios have been approved yet. Proposed method: factor = 1 + fuel_share x (FL_diesel/GA_diesel - 1) + labor_share x (FL_wage/GA_wage - 1), with all four inputs cited.

items.title: Confirm the two SSURGO map units represent irrigated corn fields in the Suwannee Valley
items.current_default: Field 1: Blanton-Alpin-Bonneau complex, 0 to 5 percent slopes; Field 2: Bonneau-Blanton-Padlock complex, 0 to 5 percent slopes
items.notes: Chosen to contrast deep sand (low water holding) with loamy sand (higher water holding). Names confirmed against SSURGO when the fetch runs.

items.title: Confirm which workbook cells feed game values (yield, price, land rent, hauling, interest)
items.current_default: First numeric cell to the right of each label (see pipeline/sources/regions/suwannee.json)
items.notes: The 2026 budgets are spreadsheets; the fetch records every numeric cell on each label row with its cell reference. The spot-check document lists them for confirmation.
